name: Property Maintenance & Handyman
description: A maintenance-request and work-order tracker for property managers and handymen: manage properties and tenants, log maintenance requests, schedule and track work orders, and record inspections. Includes 5 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: Property Maintenance & Handyman
packMeta.description: A maintenance-request and work-order tracker for property managers and handymen: manage properties and tenants, log maintenance requests, schedule and track work orders, and record inspections — all linked together.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

forms.title: Property
forms.description: Add a property with its address, type, owner or manager, and on-site access notes.

fields.label: New Property
fields.description: Capture the property details so you can track tenants, requests and inspections.

properties.placeholder: Gate codes, lockbox, parking, pets, preferred entry times…

forms.title: Tenant
forms.description: Register a tenant against a property with their contact details.

forms.title: Maintenance Request
forms.description: Log a maintenance issue reported for a property by a tenant, with category, priority and status.

properties.placeholder: Describe the issue and its location within the property…

forms.title: Work Order
forms.description: Schedule and track the work to resolve a maintenance request, with assignee, hours and cost.

properties.placeholder: Describe the work performed and any parts used…

forms.title: Inspection
forms.description: Record a property inspection with its type, overall condition rating and notes.

apps.name: Maintenance
apps.description: A property-maintenance operations hub for property managers and handymen: track properties, tenants, maintenance requests, work orders and inspections from one dashboard.

roles.name: Property Manager
roles.description: Full access to all property maintenance forms.

roles.name: Handyman
roles.description: Field handymen who work maintenance requests, complete work orders and log inspections.

roles.name: Landlord
roles.description: Property owners who log requests and review work on their properties.
